thread:
alex chen: Kicking off a promote for model v3-int4 -> 10% traffic. Quick sanity check first — saw MRR -0.8pt on shadow but latency down ~35%.
maria gomez: Thanks. Can you paste the per-slice deltas? especially longdocs and rerank slices.
alex chen: longdocs +1.2 latency win, MRR -1.5; short answers MRR -0.2; rerank MRR -0.9. Overall user-impact weighted -0.8.
samir: Product: what's the user-visible risk for the -0.8? Any regression in safety/hallucination?
maria gomez: Hallucination flagged +1.1pts on our eval (precision drop). That's the main concern. We should be conservative with auto-fallback thresholds.
devon (sre): Operationally we prefer gradual ramp (10 -> 25 -> 50) with circuit-breaker. Also want latency SLOs for tail p95 not to regress.
alex chen: Agreed. Proposed automatic fallback rules:

```json
{ "promote_plan": [10, 25, 50, 100], "checks": { "mrr_drop_pct": 0.6, "slice_mrr_drop_pct": 1.0, "hallucination_abs_pts": 0.8, "latency_p95_ms_increase": 50, "continuous_fail_window_secs": 900 }, "actions": { "auto_fallback": true, "fallback_to": "v3-nt4", "notify_channels": ["#eng-ml", "#incidents", "#oncall"] } }
```

maria gomez: I think mrr_drop_pct 0.6 is reasonable for weighted MRR. For longdocs we should use slice override to 0.4 (more sensitive).
samir: Can we add a quiet-burn phase for 2 hours with doubled traffic sampling to catch flakey signals?
alex chen: Yes — add a quiet burn flag on first step: 10% quiet_burn_hours=2.
deploy-bot: CI checks passed for model binary; canary infra ready. Canary nodes: canary-01..03
oncall: I'll subscribe to alerts. Which metric will fire the rollback? exact name please.
devon (sre): Use metric name: "model.promote.mrr_weighted_delta_1h" and "model.eval.hallucination_delta_1h". Alert when either crosses configured threshold for 15 consecutive mins.
maria gomez: Also add manual hold if A/B p-value < 0.05 on critical slice comparisons.
alex chen: Plan: start 10% quiet-burn now, run 2h, check slices. If slice MRR drop >1.0 or hallucination >0.8 abs -> immediate fallback. If weighted MRR drop >0.6 sustained -> fallback. If A/B significant -> hold and escalate.
samir: Sounds good. Product approves the quiet-burn; will message support if user reports spike.
alex chen: I'll kick it off and post dashboards. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/promotes/4955551234
maria gomez: I'll run a short synthetic evaluation and post results in 30m.
alex chen: rolling out 10% quiet-burn now :rocket:
deploy-bot: promote job started at 4955551234 by alex chen. Canary monitors enabled.
oncall: Subscribed. Alerting thresholds configured in pagerduty policy #ml-promotes.
maria gomez: 30m update: synthetic eval: weighted MRR delta -0.55 (within threshold), hallucination +0.95 (exceeds slice threshold on longdocs). Kicking a targeted rollback for longdocs slice and lowering next-step to 20%.
alex chen: Acknowledged. Triggering targeted override: route longdocs back to v3-nt4, continue quiet-burn for others.
samir: Good call. Keep me posted if overall weighted MRR slips below 0.6.
alex chen: Will do. Recording decisions in the promote ticket.
